label: Reads sequenced
comment: Reads entering Hermes cleanup (the junction read).

label: Reads retained after cleanup
comment: Fraction of reads kept after Hermes/adaptor trimming and the length filter.

label: Reads with 3' adaptor
comment: Fraction of reads with adaptor at the 3' end (short fragments or primer dimers).

label: Mapped reads
comment: Primary alignments that map to the reference.

label: Mapped (%)
comment: Primary alignments that map to the reference.

label: Mapped with MAPQ above threshold (%)
comment: Uniquely placed alignments; low values mean repeats or the wrong reference.

label: Mean MAPQ
comment: Mean mapping quality of mapped primary alignments.

label: Reads at insertion sites
comment: Reads supporting called insertions.

label: Insertion sites
comment: Distinct insertion positions (strands combined).

label: Insertions per kb of genome
comment: Insertion sites per kilobase of reference: how densely the genome is covered (Hermes has no fixed set of possible sites).

label: Catalogue density
comment: Fraction of the project's catalogue (positions with an insertion in any library) that this library hits. Hermes has no fixed set of possible sites, so there is no absolute target.

label: Mean reads per catalogue site
comment: Mean reads per catalogue position, empty positions included.

label: Mean reads per occupied site
comment: Mean reads per position with an insertion; too high or too low can indicate problems.

label: Median reads per occupied site
comment: Median reads per position with an insertion; robust to spikes.

label: Max reads at a site
comment: Largest read count at one position; depends on depth, see the top site's share.

label: Top site's share of reads
comment: Fraction of all reads at the single largest site (a PCR jackpot or strong selection).

label: Top 1% of sites' share of reads
comment: Fraction of reads at the top 1% of sites; high values mean a few sites dominate.

label: Skewness
comment: Skewness of the read counts at occupied sites: above 30 often signals a problem, below 50 is desired (can be higher under strong selection).

label: Kurtosis
comment: Excess kurtosis of the read counts at occupied sites; not very meaningful on its own.

label: Tail index (Pickands)
comment: Heaviness of the upper tail of the read counts; higher means a few sites carry more of the reads.

label: Strand correlation (W vs C)
comment: Correlation of read counts on the two strands at a position. For Hermes the two orientations are separate insertions, so it is shown, not flagged.

label: Genes hit (%)
comment: SummaryTable: features with at least one insertion.

label: Insertions per gene
comment: SummaryTable: mean insertion sites per feature.

label: Insertions in genes (%)
comment: SummaryTable: share of insertion sites inside features.

label: Insertion-neighbourhood correlation
comment: SummaryTable: Spearman correlation between a gene's insertions and its neighbourhood's.

label: MidLC estimate
comment: Library diagnostics: reads at which half the discoverable sites are found.

label: Depth / MidLC
comment: Reads at insertion sites divided by the MidLC estimate (above 1: sequenced past half-saturation).

label: Reads in jackpot sites
comment: Library diagnostics: fraction of reads in the top jackpot sites.

label: Jackpot sites
comment: Library diagnostics: number of sites flagged as jackpots.
